code_audit_findings.summary: Quartic convention mismatch: Branco/CE beta functions and stability check (l3+l4+sqrt(l1*l2)>0) initialized with no-1/2 D-term values l1=l2=(g2^2+(3/5)g1^2)/8=0.05 instead of /4=0.10, violating UV stability at t=0 (-0.05 < 0) and shifting all reported l1_IR, l2_IR by ~2x vs no-1/2 convention.

Guardrail 4 literature transcription error in 2-loop Type-II 2HDM beta functions: uses -29/240*g1^2*Hd in beta_Yu^(2) and -65/240*g1^2*Hu in beta_Yd^(2) instead of exact Chowdhury-Eberhardt (arXiv:1503.08216) & Luo-Wang-Xiao (hep-ph/0211440) -41/240 and -53/240, and copied -29/240 into its own benchmark formula at line 1790.

DynamicV4_ferro_CURVED_s12 ordering & Y_nu assignment: v3 minimizes flat V_4(h_u,h_d) before applying curved G_{s=1/2} and keeps static S(tau) for Y_nu in Piece 3, whereas Referee minimizes V_4 in the canonical curved basis G^{-1/2} Y G^{-1/2} and couples Y_nu to h_u*.
